policies.text: **Document ID:** POL-MB-009 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 15, 2026 **Department:** Customer Experience — Marketplace **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---

This policy outlines the protections and rights afforded to buyers purchasing from third-party sellers on the The Platform Marketplace. It complements the Returns & Refunds Policy and the Marketplace Seller Policy.

- Buyers have the right to receive products that match the seller's listing, including: - Product description, specifications, and dimensions - Condition (new, refurbished, used — as stated) - Images (must be representative; no stock photos that misrepresent the actual product) - Country of origin and material composition - If a product does not match the listing, the buyer is entitled to a full refund + return shipping at the seller's expense.

- Buyers have the right to receive their order within the delivery timeline stated on the product page at the time of purchase. - If the delivery is late by more than **5 business days** beyond the estimated delivery date: - The buyer may cancel the order for a full refund. - The buyer may choose to wait, in which case the seller must provide a revised delivery estimate.

- Buyers have the right to a response from the seller within **48 hours** of contacting them through the The Platform messaging platform. - If the seller fails to respond, the buyer may escalate directly to The Platform without waiting further.

- Buyers have the right to return marketplace items per the seller's stated return policy (which must meet The Platform's minimum standards of a 15-day return window). - For items that arrive damaged, defective, or materially different from the listing, the buyer has the right to a full refund regardless of the seller's return policy.
- Buyers must provide accurate and complete shipping addresses. - Failed deliveries due to incorrect addresses are the buyer's responsibility, and reshipping costs apply.

- Issues with orders (damaged, missing, wrong item) must be reported within **5 business days** of delivery. - Late claims may be handled at The Platform's discretion but are not guaranteed coverage under A-to-Z protection.

- Buyers must act in good faith when filing claims and return requests. - Fraudulent claims (returning different items, claiming non-receipt when delivery is confirmed with photo) result in account penalties. - Buyers with excessive claim rates (>20% of marketplace purchases in any 6-month period) may be flagged for review.

The buyer receives a **full refund** (product price + original shipping) in these situations: - Item not received (confirmed non-delivery or no tracking update for 7+ days) - Item materially different from listing - Item arrived damaged or defective - Seller failed to respond to return request within 48 hours - Seller refused a valid return within their stated policy - Counterfeit item received (verified by The Platform)

A **partial refund** may be issued when: - Buyer returns an item outside the seller's return window but within 30 days of delivery (50-80% refund at The Platform's discretion) - Item shows signs of use beyond what is necessary to inspect it (per seller's assessment, validated by The Platform) - Buyer and seller agree to a partial refund as a resolution without full return

A refund is **not issued** when: - The buyer failed to report the issue within the reporting window and no evidence supports the claim - The product matches the listing and functions as described (buyer's remorse on a 3P no-return item) - The buyer has already received a chargeback from their bank for the same transaction

1. **Step 1:** Buyer contacts the seller through The Platform messaging 2. **Step 2:** If seller doesn't respond in 48 hours or resolution is unsatisfactory → Buyer files an A-to-Z claim 3. **Step 3:** The Platform Marketplace Support reviews the claim (5 business days) 4. **Step 4:** Decision issued — refund, partial refund, or claim denied (with reason) 5. **Step 5:** Either party may appeal within 7 days; final decision within 5 business days 6. **Step 6:** If the buyer is still dissatisfied after appeal → External arbitration through The Platform's dispute resolution partner (optional, binding) --- **Policy Contact:** buyer-support@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Marketplace buyer issues → Marketplace Trust & Safety at marketplace-safety@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of Customer Experience

**Document ID:** POL-FP-010 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 18, 2026 **Department:** Trust & Safety **Classification:** Internal Policy — Confidential (Customer-Facing Summary) ---

This policy outlines The Platform's approach to fraud prevention, account security, unauthorized access, and identity theft protection. It applies to all customer accounts and transactions on the platform.

- Minimum **8 characters** with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character - Passwords are hashed using **bcrypt** and never stored in plaintext - Password reuse of the last 5 passwords is not permitted - Account lockout after **5 consecutive failed login attempts** (30-minute lockout, extendable)

- Available for all accounts; **mandatory** for Platinum tier members - Supported methods: SMS code, authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy), email code - 2FA is required for: password changes, payment method changes, address additions, and orders over $500

- Customers who lose access can recover their account through: 1. **Email verification:** A reset link sent to the registered email 2. **Phone verification:** An OTP sent to the registered phone number 3. **Identity verification:** Upload of a government-issued ID (processed within 24-48 hours) - Account recovery resets the 2FA settings, and the customer must re-enable 2FA after accessing their account

Every transaction is screened in real-time for fraud indicators: - **Address Verification System (AVS):** Billing address is checked against the card issuer's records - **Card Verification Value (CVV):** Required for all card transactions - **Velocity checks:** Multiple orders from the same account, IP, or card within a short period - **Behavioral analysis:** Unusual browsing patterns, rapid price-point escalation, or large first-time orders - **Device fingerprinting:** Identification of device attributes to detect known fraudulent devices

Orders are escalated for manual review if they exhibit: - Shipping address in a different country from the billing address (for first-time orders) - Order value exceeding **$1,000** (first-time customers only) - Multiple payment method failures followed by a successful payment - Use of known fraud-associated email domains or proxy/VPN IP addresses - Request for overnight shipping on high-value electronics (first-time customer)

- Manual reviews are completed within **2-4 hours** during business hours, **8-12 hours** outside business hours - During review, the order is placed on "Payment Verification" hold — the customer sees a notification explaining the delay - If the order passes review, it proceeds to fulfillment - If the order fails review, it is cancelled, the payment is voided, and the customer is notified with next steps (identity verification or alternative payment)
The Platform monitors for unauthorized account activity including: - Logins from new devices or locations - Changes to payment information - Changes to shipping addresses - Unusual order patterns

If a customer suspects unauthorized activity: 1. **Immediately** contact The Platform support via the "Report Unauthorized Activity" button in Account Settings or by calling the Priority Security Line 2. The Platform freezes the account within **15 minutes** of a verified report 3. All pending orders are held for review 4. Recent orders (last 72 hours) are reviewed for unauthorized transactions

- Unauthorized transactions are fully reversed (refunded) within **3 business days** of confirmation - The customer receives a new account with transferred loyalty status and points (if verified identity match) - A detailed incident report is provided to the customer for their records (useful for filing police reports) - The Platform cooperates with law enforcement investigations when required

policies.section: 5.1 Empty Box / Wrong Item Return Fraud
policies.text: - All returned items are inspected at the fulfillment center before refunds are processed - Weight verification is performed on received packages and compared to expected weight - Serial numbers (for electronics) are checked against the original shipment - Discrepancies result in refund denial and investigation

Accounts flagged for potential claim abuse: - **3 or more** "item not received" claims within 6 months - Return rate exceeding **40%** of purchases in any 90-day period - Multiple claims on high-value items ($200+) within a short period - Claims that contradict delivery photo evidence

- First offense: Warning email and account flag - Second offense: Loss of return privileges for 90 days - Third offense: Account suspension pending review by Trust & Safety - Confirmed fraud: Permanent account ban, referral to law enforcement, and debt collection for any unrecovered funds

policies.section: 6.1 If a Customer's Identity Is Used to Create a The Platform Account
policies.text: - The victim should contact The Platform immediately with: 1. A government-issued photo ID 2. A police report or FTC Identity Theft Report 3. Any The Platform order numbers or account details if known - The Platform will close the fraudulent account within **24 hours** of verification - Any outstanding charges or collections associated with the fraudulent account are halted - The Platform issues a letter confirming the identity theft for the victim's records

- In the event of a data breach affecting customer data, The Platform will: 1. Notify affected customers within **72 hours** of discovery (per regulatory requirements) 2. Provide free credit monitoring for **12 months** 3. Reset all affected account passwords 4. Offer identity theft insurance through a partner service --- **Policy Contact:** security@The Platform.com **Urgent Security Line:** 1-800-SHOP-SEC (available 24/7) **Escalation:** Account security → Trust & Safety Lead at trust-safety@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** Chief Security Officer
**Document ID:** POL-WR-011 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 10, 2026 **Department:** Product Quality & Compliance **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---
This policy outlines the warranty coverage, claims process, and limitations for products sold on The Platform. Warranty coverage varies by product category and seller type.

- **Electronics (laptops, tablets, phones, monitors):** 1-year limited warranty from the date of delivery - **Small appliances (blenders, coffee makers, toasters):** 1-year limited warranty - **Large appliances (refrigerators, washers, dryers):** 2-year limited warranty - **Furniture:** 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects - **Clothing and accessories:** 90-day warranty against manufacturing defects (stitching, zippers, fabric tears under normal use) - **Toys and sports equipment:** 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects

The The Platform Standard Warranty covers: - Manufacturing defects (hardware malfunction, component failure under normal use) - Materials defects (premature wear, discoloration, or degradation under normal conditions) - Assembly defects (parts missing from factory, misaligned components)

The warranty does NOT cover: - **Physical damage:** Drops, spills, cracks, scratches, or any damage resulting from misuse, abuse, or accidents - **Water damage:** Unless the product is rated as water-resistant/waterproof (e.g., IP67/IP68) - **Normal wear and tear:** Battery degradation, cosmetic wear, fading - **Unauthorized modifications:** Products modified, rooted, jailbroken, or repaired by unauthorized service providers - **Software issues:** Operating system bugs, third-party app compatibility, or malware (for electronics) - **Consumable components:** Battery replacements beyond 6 months, printer ink/toner, filters, bulbs - **Cosmetic imperfections:** Minor scratches or blemishes that do not affect functionality - **Acts of God:** Damage caused by natural disasters, power surges (unless a surge protector was used and failed), or extreme environmental conditions

- **1-Year Extension:** Extends coverage by 12 months after the standard warranty expires. Cost: 8-12% of product price. - **2-Year Extension:** Extends coverage by 24 months. Cost: 14-18% of product price. - **Accidental Damage Protection (ADP):** Covers drops, spills, and cracks. Can be added to either extension plan for an additional 5% of product price.

In addition to standard warranty coverage, the extended warranty includes: - **Power surge protection:** Coverage for damage caused by power surges - **Mechanical/electrical failure:** Extended coverage for component failures beyond the standard period - **No deductibles:** All covered claims are processed without deductibles - **Replacement guarantee:** If the product cannot be repaired, a replacement of equal or greater value is provided

- Extended warranty plans can be purchased at the time of product purchase (at checkout) or within **30 days** of delivery - Plans cannot be purchased after 30 days from delivery - Plans are non-transferable and tied to the original purchaser's The Platform account - Plans are non-refundable after 30 days of purchase (full refund available within 30 days if no claims have been filed)

1. Go to the The Platform Warranty Center (Order History → Select Item → "Warranty Claim") 2. Describe the issue and provide supporting photos/videos 3. The Platform reviews the claim within **3 business days** 4. If approved: - For items under $100: A replacement is shipped, and the customer is NOT required to return the defective item - For items $100+: A prepaid return label is provided; replacement/refund is issued upon receipt and inspection of the defective item 5. If denied: The customer receives a detailed explanation and may appeal within **14 days**

- The Platform reserves the right to repair or replace the defective product at its discretion - If a replacement of the exact model is unavailable, a comparable or upgraded model is offered - The customer may choose a full refund instead of a replacement (refund based on the current depreciated value for claims outside the first 6 months — see depreciation schedule below)

| Claim Timing | Refund Value | |--------------|-------------| | 0-6 months | 100% of purchase price | | 6-12 months | 85% of purchase price | | 12-18 months (extended warranty) | 70% of purchase price | | 18-24 months (extended warranty) | 60% of purchase price | | 24+ months (extended warranty) | 50% of purchase price |

- Third-party sellers may offer their own warranty terms, which are displayed on the product page - Seller warranties are administered by the seller, not The Platform - The Platform does not guarantee or take responsibility for seller warranty claims - If a seller fails to honor their stated warranty, the customer may file an A-to-Z claim (see Marketplace Seller Policy)

- Many products sold on The Platform (both 1P and 3P) come with manufacturer warranties - Manufacturer warranty claims must be filed directly with the manufacturer - The Platform provides the purchase receipt and proof of authenticity upon customer request to facilitate manufacturer warranty claims - The Platform is not a party to manufacturer warranty agreements

- Per EU law, consumers have a minimum **2-year legal guarantee** on all consumer goods, regardless of the seller's stated warranty period - This legal guarantee covers any defect that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery - For defects appearing within the first **12 months**, the defect is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery (burden of proof on the seller)

- UK consumers are protected by the **Consumer Rights Act 2015**, which provides a 30-day right to reject faulty goods for a full refund, and up to **6 years** to claim for goods that do not conform to the contract

- Australian Consumer Law provides guarantees that cannot be excluded by warranty terms. Products must be of acceptable quality, fit for purpose, and match their description, regardless of warranty period --- **Policy Contact:** warranty@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Warranty disputes → Quality Assurance Manager at warranty-escalation@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of Product Quality
**Document ID:** POL-PM-005 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 5, 2026 **Department:** Finance & Payments **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---
This policy outlines the accepted payment methods, billing procedures, payment security measures, and dispute resolution processes for all transactions on the The Platform platform.

- **Visa** (credit, debit, prepaid) - **Mastercard** (credit, debit, prepaid) - **American Express** (credit only) - **Discover** (credit, debit) - All cards must be 3D Secure enabled for transactions over $500.

- **PayPal** (including PayPal Credit and Pay in 4) - **Apple Pay** (on iOS devices and Safari browser) - **Google Pay** (on Android devices and Chrome browser) - **The Platform Wallet** (preloaded balance, store credit, or gift card balance) - **Amazon Pay** (via integrated checkout)

- **Affirm:** Available for purchases between $50 and $5,000. 0% APR for select items (promotional periods), otherwise standard APR applies. - **Klarna:** Pay in 4 installments (interest-free) for purchases up to $1,000. Monthly financing for large purchases. - **Afterpay:** 4 interest-free installments for purchases between $35 and $2,000. - BNPL is not available for gift cards, digital products, or subscription orders.

- Available for domestic orders within the US (select regions) and India. - COD orders are limited to a maximum value of **$200 (US)** or **₹15,000 (India)**. - A flat COD handling fee of **$2.99 (US)** or **₹49 (India)** applies. - COD is not available for marketplace/third-party seller items or pre-orders.

- The Platform gift cards (physical and digital) can be used as full or partial payment. - Multiple gift cards can be combined on a single order. - Store credit earned through returns, promotions, or loyalty rewards is automatically applied to the The Platform Wallet. - Gift cards cannot be used to purchase other gift cards.

- The Platform accepts **Bitcoin (BTC)** and **Ethereum (ETH)** via the Coinbase Commerce integration. - Available for select product categories only. Not available for subscription orders. - Cryptocurrency payments are final and non-refundable. Refunds for crypto payments are issued as The Platform Store Credit. - This is a beta feature and may be discontinued without notice.

- When an order is placed, The Platform places an **authorization hold** on the payment method for the full order amount. - The hold is not a charge — it temporarily reserves funds to ensure they are available when the order ships. - Authorization holds are released automatically if the order is cancelled or after **7 days** if the order has not shipped. - Some banks may take up to **10 business days** to release expired authorization holds.

- **Credit/Debit Cards:** Charged when the order ships (not when placed). - **PayPal:** Charged immediately upon order confirmation. - **Digital Wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay):** Charged when the order ships. - **BNPL:** First installment charged immediately; subsequent installments per the BNPL provider's schedule. - **Gift Cards/Store Credit:** Deducted immediately upon order confirmation. - **COD:** Collected at the time of delivery by the carrier. - **Cryptocurrency:** Charged immediately upon order confirmation (blockchain confirmation required).

- For multi-item orders, The Platform may process separate charges if items ship from different fulfillment centers or at different times. - Each charge corresponds to a shipment and includes only the items in that specific shipment. - The customer's bank statement may show multiple charges that, combined, equal the original order total.

- All transactions are screened through The Platform's fraud detection system, which evaluates: - Billing and shipping address match - Transaction amount vs. historical spending patterns - Device fingerprint and IP geolocation - Velocity checks (multiple orders in a short period) - Orders flagged as potentially fraudulent are placed on hold for **manual review** (up to 24 hours). - The customer may be asked to verify their identity through a secondary verification step (SMS code, email verification, or ID upload).

- All payment data is encrypted using **TLS 1.3** during transmission. - The Platform is **PCI DSS Level 1** compliant. Card data is never stored on The Platform servers; it is tokenized through our payment processor. - Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is available and recommended for account security.

- If a payment is declined, the customer is notified immediately and given the opportunity to: 1. Retry with the same payment method 2. Use an alternative payment method 3. Contact their bank/card issuer - Orders with declined payments are held for **24 hours** before automatic cancellation. - If the customer's card is repeatedly declined (3+ attempts), the order is cancelled, and the customer is asked to contact their bank.

- Customers should first contact The Platform support before filing a payment dispute with their bank/card issuer. - The Platform resolves most disputes within **48 hours** of initial contact. - If a dispute cannot be resolved through support, the customer may escalate to the Payment Disputes team.

- If a customer files a chargeback with their bank without first contacting The Platform: - The Platform will attempt to resolve the issue and may provide evidence to the card issuer to contest the chargeback. - Orders associated with successful chargebacks are treated as returns, and any future orders from the account may be subject to additional verification. - Accounts with **3 or more chargebacks** in a 12-month period are subject to suspension and review by the Trust & Safety team.

- If a customer identifies an unauthorized charge from The Platform: 1. Contact The Platform support immediately 2. The account is frozen pending investigation 3. Unauthorized transactions are fully refunded within **3 business days** of confirmation 4. The customer is advised to update their password and enable 2FA

- All prices on The Platform are displayed exclusive of tax (pre-tax) for US customers. - International prices may or may not include VAT/GST depending on the destination (see International Shipping Policy).

- The Platform collects applicable state and local sales tax based on the shipping destination. - The Platform is registered for sales tax collection in all 50 US states and DC where applicable. - Tax-exempt customers (e.g., qualifying organizations) may apply for tax-exempt status by uploading a valid exemption certificate. Processing takes 3-5 business days.

- All domestic US transactions are in USD. - International customers see prices in their local currency (converted at checkout using live exchange rates). - The actual charge amount may vary slightly from the displayed amount due to exchange rate fluctuations between checkout and payment processing. --- **Policy Contact:** payments@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Payment disputes → Payment Disputes Team at payment-disputes@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of Finance

**Document ID:** POL-LP-007 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 1, 2026 **Department:** Customer Experience & Retention **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---

The The Platform Loyalty Program rewards repeat customers with exclusive discounts, perks, and priority services across all tiers. This policy defines the program structure, earning and redemption rules, and tier benefits.

- Tier qualification is based on **cumulative spend** within a **rolling 12-month period** (calendar months, not from enrollment date). - Only eligible purchases count toward tier qualification. Excluded: gift cards, taxes, shipping charges, and items that were returned. - Tier status is evaluated monthly. If spend falls below the qualification threshold at the end of the 12-month rolling period, the customer is demoted one tier (with a **30-day grace period** before benefits change). - Tier promotions (upgrades) are applied **immediately** upon reaching a spend threshold.

- **Base rate:** 1 point per $1 spent (before tax, after discounts) - Points multipliers apply based on tier (see table above) - **Bonus points events:** The Platform runs 2x/3x/5x bonus point events throughout the year, announced via email - Points are credited after the return window closes (30 days from delivery) to prevent earn-and-return abuse

- Points can be redeemed for **The Platform Wallet credit** at a rate of **100 points = $1.00** - Minimum redemption: **500 points** ($5.00) - Points can be redeemed at checkout or through the Loyalty dashboard - Points cannot be redeemed for cash, transferred to another account, or used to purchase gift cards

- Points expire **18 months** after being earned if no purchase or redemption activity occurs on the account - At least one qualifying purchase or redemption within any 18-month window resets the expiration clock for ALL points - Expired points are non-recoverable - Customers receive email reminders **60 days** and **30 days** before points are set to expire
- Access to the The Platform Loyalty points system - Birthday discount: 10% off (max $20), valid 7 days - Early access to annual sale events (2 hours before general public)

All Bronze benefits plus: - **Free standard shipping** on all orders (no minimum) - Birthday discount: 15% off (max $30), valid 7 days - Exclusive Silver-only promotional events (2-3 per year) - Priority email support (48-hour response guarantee)

All Silver benefits plus: - **Free expedited shipping** on orders over $75 - Birthday discount: 20% off (max $50), valid 7 days - **Extended return window:** 45 days (vs. standard 30 days) - **5% loyalty discount** on select categories (home, fashion, electronics) — auto-applied at checkout - Dedicated support queue (4-hour response guarantee) - Early access to new product launches (24 hours before general availability)

All Gold benefits plus: - **Free standard, expedited, overnight shipping** on all orders + **free same-day delivery** in eligible metro areas - Birthday discount: 25% off (max $75), valid 14 days - **Extended return window:** 60 days - **10% loyalty discount** on all categories — auto-applied at checkout - **Priority customer support:** Dedicated Platinum phone line with <2 minute wait time - **Concierge service:** Personal shopping assistant for product recommendations and VIP access to limited-edition products - **$20 inconvenience credit** for The Platform-initiated cancellations (vs. $10 for other tiers) - Annual **$50 loyalty bonus credit** (credited to The Platform Wallet on the account anniversary) - Free gift wrapping on all orders - Exclusive invitations to The Platform partner events and brand previews

- Each customer is limited to **one loyalty account** per person - Loyalty accounts are tied to the customer's verified email address and cannot be merged after creation - Points and tier status are non-transferable between accounts - Households sharing an address may have separate loyalty accounts, but The Platform may review unusual earning patterns

- Purchasing items solely for the purpose of earning points and subsequently returning them ("churning") is prohibited - Accounts exhibiting churning behavior may have points revoked and tier status frozen - Using multiple accounts to circumvent referral limits or accumulate benefits is a violation of Terms of Service

- The Platform reserves the right to modify tier thresholds, benefits, and point values with **60 days' notice** to members - Material changes are communicated via email and in-app notification - Points earned before a program change retain their value through the transition period (minimum 90 days) --- **Policy Contact:** loyalty@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Loyalty issues → Loyalty Program Manager at loyalty-escalation@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of Customer Experience
**Document ID:** POL-PO-006 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 20, 2026 **Department:** Marketing & Revenue **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---

This policy governs all promotional offers, discount codes, coupons, flash sales, and special pricing events on the The Platform platform. All support agents must reference this policy when handling promo-related inquiries.

- Alphanumeric codes entered at checkout (e.g., SAVE20, WELCOME10). - Types: - **Percentage discount:** e.g., 20% off (capped at a maximum discount amount) - **Fixed amount discount:** e.g., $15 off orders over $75 - **Free shipping:** Overrides standard shipping charges - **BOGO (Buy One, Get One):** Free or discounted item on qualifying purchases
- Applied automatically at checkout without needing a code - Displayed on product pages and in the cart - Examples: "Buy 3, Get 10% Off," seasonal auto-discounts, bulk pricing

- Limited-time sales events lasting **2-24 hours** - Products are discounted by **20-70%** during the event - Quantities are limited — once stock runs out, the sale price expires - No rainchecks: If an item sells out during a flash sale, The Platform does not honor the sale price for future restocking

- Available only to members of the The Platform Loyalty Program - Typically **5-15%** additional discount on select categories - Loyalty offers can be combined with certain promo codes (see stacking rules in Section 4)

- **Referrer:** Receives a **$10 credit** when the referred person makes their first purchase of $50+ - **Referred customer:** Receives **15% off** their first order (max $25 discount) - Referral credits expire **90 days** after being issued - Maximum **10 referral credits** per account per calendar year - Referral benefits do not apply to gift card purchases or subscription orders

- Loyalty members receive a **20% off** coupon valid for 7 days around their birthday (3 days before through 4 days after) - Maximum discount: $50 - Valid on a single order; non-transferable - Cannot be combined with other percentage-based coupons

- Only **one promo code** can be applied per order (unless specifically stated as stackable). - Promo codes are case-insensitive (e.g., SAVE20 = save20). - Minimum purchase requirements must be met after other discounts and before tax/shipping. - Promo codes cannot be applied retroactively to orders that have already been placed. - Promo codes cannot be used on: gift cards, digital subscriptions, marketplace seller items (unless the seller participates), or items already marked as "Final Sale."

- All promo codes have an expiration date displayed in the promotional email/advertisement. - Expired promo codes cannot be honored. Support agents are not authorized to extend or reactivate expired promo codes. - Exception: If a promo code fails due to a **technical glitch** during its valid period (documented by the engineering team), a one-time manual discount may be applied by a support supervisor.

- Some promo codes are region-specific (e.g., US-only, EU-only). - The geographic restriction is based on the **shipping address**, not the billing address or account location. - Region-specific promos are clearly labeled in the promotional material.

- **Single-use codes:** Tied to a specific customer account. Cannot be shared or reused. (e.g., JANE-WELCOME-15) - **Multi-use codes:** Can be used by any customer, subject to an overall redemption limit. (e.g., SUMMER25 — valid for the first 5,000 redemptions) - Abuse of multi-use codes (e.g., creating multiple accounts) is a violation of The Platform Terms of Service and may result in order cancellation and account suspension.

| Promo Type | + Promo Code | + Auto Discount | + Loyalty Discount | + Free Ship Promo | |-----------|-------------|---------------|-------------------|-----------------| | **Promo Code** | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | | **Auto Discount** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Loyalty Discount** | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | | **Free Ship Promo** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | **Summary:** - You **CANNOT** combine two promo codes. - You **CANNOT** combine a promo code with a loyalty-exclusive discount. - Automatic discounts stack with everything except another automatic discount on the same item. - Free shipping promos stack with most other offers.

When multiple valid discounts apply, they are applied in this order: 1. Automatic discounts (product-level) 2. Promo code discount (order-level) 3. Loyalty tier discount (if no promo code is applied) 4. Store credit / gift card balance 5. Free shipping (if applicable)

- The Platform will match a lower price from a **qualifying competitor** if the customer reports it within **7 days** of purchase. - **Qualifying competitors:** Amazon.com, Walmart.com, Target.com, BestBuy.com (US only) - The item must be identical (same model, brand, SKU, condition — new only). - The competitor's price must be their current, publicly listed price (not a clearance, outlet, or membership-exclusive price). - The price match is applied as a refund of the difference to the original payment method.

- Marketplace/third-party seller items (on either The Platform or the competitor) - Items purchased during flash sales or with promo codes - Bundle deals or combo offers - Items with a purchase limit (e.g., "limit 2 per customer") - Prices that appear to be the result of a technical error - International prices (price matching is US domestic only)

1. Verify the code is valid (not expired, correct spelling). 2. Check product eligibility (not a restricted category). 3. Check minimum order value. 4. Check geographic restriction. 5. If all conditions are met and the code still fails, escalate to the Promotions Team with the promo code, order number, and screenshots.

- Promo codes **cannot** be applied after order placement. - If the order has not yet shipped, the customer may cancel and re-order with the coupon applied. - Support agents are **not authorized** to apply retroactive discounts or issue manual credits in lieu of a coupon, unless approved by a supervisor.

policies.section: 6.3 "The Sale Price Changed Before I Checked Out"
policies.text: - Flash sale and promotional prices are valid only while stock lasts and during the stated promotion period. - If a customer had the item in their cart but the price changed before checkout, The Platform is not obligated to honor the previous price. - As a goodwill gesture, a supervisor may approve a **5% courtesy discount** (max $20) for affected customers. --- **Policy Contact:** promotions@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Promotion issues → Marketing Operations Lead at promo-escalation@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of Marketing

**Document ID:** POL-MS-008 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 15, 2026 **Department:** Marketplace Operations **Classification:** Internal Policy — Seller & Customer-Facing ---

The Platform operates as both a direct retailer and a marketplace platform. This policy governs the relationship between The Platform, third-party sellers, and customers for marketplace transactions. It outlines seller obligations, customer protections, and dispute resolution for marketplace orders.

- **The Platform Direct (1P):** Products sold and fulfilled by The Platform. Full The Platform policies apply. - **Fulfilled by The Platform (FBS):** Products sold by third-party sellers but stored, packed, and shipped by The Platform fulfillment centers. The Platform return/shipping policies apply. - **Seller-Fulfilled (3P):** Products sold and shipped directly by the third-party seller. Seller's own return/refund policies apply, subject to The Platform minimum standards (see Section 3).

- The product page clearly identifies the seller: "Sold by [Seller Name]" and "Fulfilled by [The Platform/Seller Name]." - Customers can filter search results by fulfillment type. - The order confirmation email specifies the seller and fulfillment method for each item.

Third-party sellers on The Platform must adhere to the following minimum return standards: - **Return window:** At least **15 days** from delivery (vs. The Platform's 30-day standard) - **Refund processing:** Within **7 business days** of receiving the returned item - **Damaged/defective items:** Full refund + free return shipping (mandatory, non-negotiable) - **Wrong item received:** Full refund + free return shipping + immediate correct item shipment (if available) - Sellers may offer more generous policies but cannot fall below these minimums.

- Sellers must ship orders within **3 business days** of order confirmation (or the listed handling time, whichever is longer) - All shipments must include tracking information uploaded to the The Platform platform within **24 hours** of shipment - Sellers must achieve a minimum on-time delivery rate of **90%** - Sellers falling below shipping performance standards receive warnings; repeated violations result in listing suspension

- Sellers must respond to customer messages within **24 hours** (business days) - Sellers must provide clear, accurate product listings (description, dimensions, materials, images) - Misleading or inaccurate listings result in listing removal and potential seller account suspension

All marketplace purchases are covered by the The Platform A-to-Z Purchase Protection program: - **Coverage:** If a seller fails to deliver the item, sends the wrong item, sends a materially different item, or refuses a valid return — the customer can file an A-to-Z claim. - **Filing window:** Within **30 days** of the latest estimated delivery date, or within **30 days** of the return request (if return-related). - **Process:** 1. Customer contacts the seller first and waits **48 hours** for a response. 2. If unresolved, the customer files an A-to-Z claim through the Resolution Center. 3. The Platform reviews the claim within **5 business days**. 4. If the claim is approved, The Platform issues a **full refund** from its own funds and recovers the amount from the seller.

A-to-Z claims are eligible when: - Item not received and tracking shows no delivery - Item received is materially different from the listing (wrong product, wrong size, damaged beyond use) - Seller refuses a return that falls within the seller's stated return policy - Seller does not respond to the customer within 48 hours of a return/issue request A-to-Z claims are NOT eligible when: - Customer has already received a refund from the seller - The dispute is about personal taste or subjective quality (not a defect or mismatch) - The item was damaged after delivery due to customer handling - The customer filed a chargeback with their bank (cannot dual-claim)

1. Customer initiates a return through the The Platform Returns Center 2. The return request is sent to the seller with a **48-hour response deadline** 3. Seller provides a return shipping label or instructions 4. Customer ships the item back using the provided method 5. Seller inspects and processes the refund 6. If the seller does not respond or refuses without valid reason, The Platform intervenes (see A-to-Z protection)

- All communications between buyers and sellers must go through the The Platform messaging system for record-keeping. - The Platform may review message history when resolving disputes. - Harassment, threats, or abusive language in messages results in immediate action against the offending party.

| Step | Action | Deadline | |------|--------|----------| | 1 | Customer contacts seller | — | | 2 | Seller responds | 48 hours | | 3 | If unresolved, customer files A-to-Z claim | Within 30 days | | 4 | The Platform reviews claim | 5 business days | | 5 | Decision issued; refund or denial with explanation | Same day as review | | 6 | Appeal (if denied) | Within 7 days | | 7 | Final appeal decision | 5 business days |

- Sellers with an A-to-Z claim rate exceeding **1%** of total orders receive a warning - Sellers with a claim rate exceeding **2%** have listing visibility reduced - Sellers with a claim rate exceeding **5%** are subject to account suspension and review - Claim rate is calculated on a rolling 90-day basis

- Selling counterfeit, replica, or knockoff items on The Platform is strictly prohibited - A single verified counterfeit complaint results in **immediate listing removal** and investigation - Confirmed counterfeit sellers face **permanent account termination** and funds withholding - Customers who receive suspected counterfeit items should report through the "Report Counterfeit" button on the order page

- Recalled products - Expired consumables (food, supplements, cosmetics past expiration date) - Items that infringe intellectual property rights - Regulated items without proper documentation (e.g., FDA-regulated supplements without labeling compliance) --- **Policy Contact:** marketplace@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Marketplace disputes → Marketplace Trust & Safety at marketplace-safety@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of Marketplace Operations

**Document ID:** POL-SI-003 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 12, 2026 **Department:** Logistics & Fulfillment — International **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---

This policy covers all international shipping operations for The Platform, applicable to shipments destined outside the United States. It includes customs, duties, delivery timelines, and country-specific restrictions.

The following countries receive full The Platform international support with expedited options: - **North America:** Canada, Mexico - **Europe:** United Kingdom, Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Ireland, Sweden, Belgium, Austria, Switzerland, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Poland, Portugal - **Asia-Pacific:** Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, India - **Middle East:** United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia

Standard international shipping only. No expedited or overnight options: - All other EU member states not listed in Tier 1 - Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia - South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt - Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam - Israel, Turkey

The Platform does not ship to the following due to regulatory or logistical constraints: - Countries under US sanctions (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Crimea region) - Countries with unreliable postal systems where shipment insurance is unavailable

- **Delivery Time:** 10-21 business days - **Cost:** Starts at $14.99 (varies by weight, dimensions, and destination) - **Carriers:** USPS International, DHL eCommerce - **Tracking:** Available but may be limited within destination country

- **Delivery Time:** 5-10 business days - **Cost:** Starts at $24.99 (varies by destination) - **Carriers:** DHL Express, UPS Worldwide Expedited, FedEx International Economy - **Tracking:** Full door-to-door tracking - **Availability:** Tier 1 countries only

- **Delivery Time:** 2-5 business days - **Cost:** Starts at $39.99 (varies by destination) - **Carriers:** DHL Express, FedEx International Priority - **Tracking:** Full real-time tracking with delivery confirmation - **Availability:** Tier 1 countries only

- All international orders may be subject to **import duties, taxes, and customs fees** imposed by the destination country's government. - **The Platform does NOT include customs duties or import taxes** in the product price or shipping cost. These are the **customer's responsibility** and are collected separately by the carrier at delivery or by the local customs authority. - Customers are advised to check their country's customs regulations before placing an order.

policies.section: 4.2 Duties Prepaid Option (DDP — Delivered Duty Paid)
policies.text: - Available for **Tier 1 countries only** at an additional cost (calculated at checkout). - The Platform pays the duties and taxes upfront so the customer has no surprise charges at delivery. - DDP pricing is an **estimate** and is non-refundable, even if actual duties are lower.

- The Platform accurately declares the value and contents of all international shipments on customs forms. - Customers must not request undervaluation or false declarations. Such requests will be declined. - Gift declarations are applied only when items are shipped to a different address from the billing address and the customer selects the "Gift" option at checkout.

- The Platform is not responsible for delays caused by customs inspection or clearance. - If a package is held in customs for more than **15 business days**, The Platform will assist the customer in contacting the carrier for resolution. - Customs rejections (e.g., prohibited items) result in the package being returned to The Platform. The customer is refunded the product price minus shipping costs.

- International customers have the same **30-day return window** from delivery (60 days for holiday purchases, extended for loyalty tiers). - EU customers retain their **14-day statutory cooling-off right** per EU consumer protection law. - UK customers have a **14-day cooling-off right** per UK Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013.

- **Customer-paid returns:** International return shipping is the customer's responsibility unless the item is damaged, defective, or incorrectly shipped. - **The Platform-paid returns:** For damaged/defective items, The Platform provides a prepaid return label for Tier 1 countries. For Tier 2 countries, The Platform reimburses up to $25 in return shipping costs upon receipt of a shipping receipt. - **Platinum members:** Free return shipping from all Tier 1 and Tier 2 countries.

- Customs duties paid by the customer on the original delivery are **NOT refunded by The Platform**, as these are collected by the destination country's government. - Customers should contact their local customs authority for duty reclaim procedures.

- Shipments under **CAD $20** are generally duty-free. - GST/HST applies to most imported goods. - The Platform offers DDP option for Canadian orders. - Delivery to remote areas (Northern Canada) may take an additional 5-10 business days.

- Per EU regulations, VAT is charged on all goods imported into the EU. - For shipments valued under **€150**, The Platform collects VAT at checkout via the EU's Import One-Stop Shop (IOSS) system, eliminating surprise charges at delivery. - For shipments over €150, customs duties + VAT are collected at delivery. - All EU returns benefit from the 14-day cooling-off period under the EU Consumer Rights Directive.

- UK VAT (20%) is collected at checkout for shipments under **£135** through the UK's simplified customs process. - For shipments over £135, duties and VAT are collected by the carrier at the point of delivery. - Post-Brexit, UK is treated as a Tier 1 international destination with full shipping options.

- Import duties on electronics can range from **10-30%** depending on the product category. - The Platform provides an estimated duty calculator at checkout for Indian customers. - Cash on Delivery is not available for international shipments to India. - Delivery in India is handled by BlueDart / DTDC for the last-mile segment.

- GST (10%) applies to all goods imported into Australia valued over **AUD $1,000**. - For goods under AUD $1,000, GST is collected at checkout by The Platform. - Certain items (e.g., food products, plant-based materials, wooden items) may be subject to inspection by the Australian Border Force.

- Consumption tax (10%) applies to all imported goods. - Customs duties vary by product category (typically 0-15% for consumer goods). - Japan Post handles the final domestic delivery. - Delivery address must be provided in both English and Japanese characters.

In addition to domestic restrictions, the following items cannot be shipped internationally: - Currency and negotiable instruments - Precious metals (gold, silver) in bulk - Weapons of any kind (including replicas) - Controlled substances and drug paraphernalia - Counterfeit goods - Any item prohibited by the destination country's import regulations

- Single package value must not exceed **$2,500** for standard international shipping. - For items valued over $2,500, only International Priority shipping with enhanced insurance is available. - Items valued over $10,000 require formal customs entry and additional documentation. --- **Policy Contact:** international@The Platform.com **Escalation:** International shipping issues → Global Logistics Manager at global-logistics@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of International Operations
**Document ID:** POL-EG-013 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 22, 2026 **Department:** Customer Experience **Classification:** Internal Policy — Agent Reference ---

This document provides guidelines for customer support agents on when and how to escalate issues beyond their standard resolution authority. Proper escalation ensures complex or sensitive issues are handled by the appropriate team.

**Authority:** - Process standard returns and refunds per policy - Apply store credits up to **$25** - Extend return windows by up to **5 days** for documented extenuating circumstances - Provide standard shipping cost waivers - Reset customer passwords and update account information (with identity verification) **Cannot:** - Override system-blocked returns (final sale, past return window beyond 5-day extension) - Issue refunds exceeding the original purchase price - Apply retroactive promo codes or discounts - Override fraud holds or account suspensions

policies.section: Level 2: Senior Support Agent / Team Lead
policies.text: **Authority:** - All Level 1 authorities plus: - Apply courtesy credits up to **$75** - Extend return windows by up to **15 days** beyond standard - Override system-blocked returns with documented justification - Apply one-time retroactive discounts (up to 15% or $50, whichever is less) - Manage seller-customer disputes (first review) - Authorize partial refunds on opened/used items at custom percentages **Cannot:** - Issue refunds over $500 without VP approval - Make exceptions to final sale/no-return policy for restricted categories (hygiene, custom items) - Override Trust & Safety decisions (fraud holds, account suspensions)

**Authority:** - All Level 2 authorities plus: - Approve refunds up to **$2,000** - Grant exceptions to non-returnable categories on a case-by-case basis (with documentation) - Override seller policies when buyer protection is warranted - Authorize re-shipment of high-value orders without return receipt - Approve escalated A-to-Z marketplace claims - Issue compensation packages (product + credit) up to $200

**Authority:** - All Level 3 authorities plus: - Approve refunds of any amount - Make policy exceptions at their discretion - Handle legal threats, media complaints, and regulatory inquiries - Authorize account reinstatement after Trust & Safety suspension - Approve compensation exceeding $200

The following situations **must** be escalated regardless of the agent's confidence: | Situation | Escalate To | |-----------|------------| | Customer mentions legal action or attorney | Level 4 (VP) + Legal Team | | Customer references media coverage or influencer status | Level 3 (Manager) | | Order involves potential counterfeit product | Trust & Safety Team | | Suspected data breach or unauthorized account access | Trust & Safety Team + Security | | Customer reports discrimination or harassment by staff | Level 4 (VP) + HR | | Order value exceeds $1,000 and issue is complex | Level 3 (Manager) | | Customer is a verified business/enterprise account | Enterprise Support Team | | Safety concern (product caused injury or property damage) | Level 4 (VP) + Product Safety Team | | Government or regulatory inquiry | Level 4 (VP) + Legal Team |

The following should generally be escalated, but agents may use judgment: - Customer is highly upset after two resolution attempts - Issue spans multiple departments (e.g., payment + shipping + seller) - Policy is ambiguous for the specific scenario - Resolution requires coordination with a third-party seller who is unresponsive - Customer has extreme loyalty (Platinum tier, 5+ years, high lifetime value)

1. **Document:** Record the full issue history, actions taken, and reason for escalation in the ticket system 2. **Warm handoff:** When possible, introduce the customer to the next-level agent (don't just transfer) 3. **Set expectations:** Tell the customer the escalation timeline (e.g., "A senior agent will contact you within 4 hours") 4. **Follow up:** Check the ticket status within 24 hours to ensure the escalation was addressed

| Escalation Level | Response Time | |-----------------|---------------| | Level 2 (Senior Agent) | Within **4 hours** (business hours) | | Level 3 (Manager) | Within **8 hours** (business hours) | | Level 4 (VP/Director) | Within **24 hours** | | Legal Team | Within **24-48 hours** | | Trust & Safety | Within **2 hours** (24/7) |

- Always confirm to the customer that their issue has been escalated and provide a reference/ticket number - Provide an estimated resolution timeline - Never promise a specific outcome ("I'll make sure you get a refund") — instead say "I've escalated this to a senior team member who has the authority to review your case" - If the customer calls back before the escalation is resolved, any agent should be able to see the escalation status and provide an update

- All Platinum member issues should be handled by the **Platinum Concierge Team** (dedicated queue) - If the Concierge Team is unavailable, escalate to Level 2 minimum - Resolution authority for Platinum members is one level higher than standard (e.g., a Level 1 agent has Level 2 authority for Platinum issues)
- Enterprise accounts have a dedicated Account Manager - All issues should be routed to the Enterprise Support Team - If the Account Manager is unavailable, escalate to Level 3

- Extra care should be taken with first-time customer issues - If a standard resolution won't fully satisfy the customer, escalate to Level 2 with a note: "First-time customer — retention priority" - Level 2 agents may offer a **$15 goodwill credit** in addition to the standard resolution

Before escalating, agents should attempt these de-escalation techniques: 1. **Acknowledge the frustration:** "I understand this is frustrating, and I want to help resolve this." 2. **Summarize the issue:** Show the customer you understand by repeating the issue back. 3. **Offer the maximum resolution within your authority:** Don't escalate when you have the tools to resolve. 4. **Explain the 'why':** If a policy prevents the desired outcome, explain the reasoning clearly. 5. **Provide alternatives:** "While I can't do X, I can offer Y." 6. Only escalate when the customer's request genuinely exceeds your authority or the situation meets a mandatory trigger. --- **Policy Contact:** escalations@The Platform.com **On-Call Escalation Manager:** Available 24/7 via internal escalation pager **Policy Owner:** VP of Customer Experience
**Document ID:** POL-PD-012 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 20, 2026 **Department:** Legal & Compliance **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---

This policy describes how The Platform collects, uses, stores, and protects customer personal data. It applies to all users of the The Platform platform, including the website, mobile app, and customer support interactions.

- **Account information:** Name, email address, phone number, date of birth, gender (optional) - **Billing information:** Credit/debit card numbers (tokenized), billing address, bank account details (for COD refunds) - **Shipping information:** Delivery addresses, delivery instructions, recipient names - **Communications:** Customer support chat transcripts, emails, phone call recordings (with consent), product reviews - **Preferences:** Language, currency, notification settings, marketing opt-in/out

- **Browsing behavior:** Pages viewed, products searched, items added to cart/wishlist, time on page - **Device information:** Browser type, operating system, device type, screen resolution, IP address - **Location data:** Approximate location based on IP address; precise location only with explicit consent (for same-day delivery) - **Transaction history:** Purchase history, return history, payment method usage - **Cookies and tracking:** Session cookies, persistent cookies, third-party analytics cookies (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel)

- Processing and fulfilling orders - Communicating about orders (confirmation, shipping, delivery) - Processing returns, refunds, and warranty claims - Managing your The Platform account and loyalty program - Fraud prevention and security monitoring - Customer support and dispute resolution
- Recommending products based on browsing and purchase history - Customizing the homepage and email content - Tailoring promotional offers based on preferences and behavior

- Order status updates (mandatory, cannot be opted out of) - Marketing emails and promotional offers (opt-in, can be unsubscribed) - Loyalty program notifications (tier changes, points expiration) - Survey and feedback requests (opt-in)

- **Payment processors:** Card networks, PayPal, BNPL providers — for transaction processing - **Shipping carriers:** Name, address, phone number — for delivery purposes - **Third-party sellers:** Name, shipping address, order details — for marketplace order fulfillment - **Analytics providers:** Aggregated, anonymized data for business intelligence (Google Analytics, Mixpanel) - **Legal/regulatory authorities:** When required by law, court order, or regulatory investigation

- Sell personal data to data brokers or advertising networks - Share full payment card details with sellers or other third parties - Use customer data for purposes other than those described in this policy without explicit consent

- **Access:** Request a copy of all personal data The Platform holds about you - **Correction:** Request correction of inaccurate personal data - **Deletion:** Request deletion of your account and associated data (subject to legal retention requirements) - **Opt-out:** Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time

In addition to the above: - **Data portability:** Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format - **Right to restrict processing:** Request that The Platform limit how your data is used - **Right to object:** Object to data processing for legitimate interests or direct marketing - **Right not to be subject to automated decision-making:** Request human review of automated decisions that significantly affect you (e.g., fraud scoring)

- **Right to know:** Request disclosure of categories and specific pieces of personal information collected - **Right to delete:** Request deletion of personal information - **Right to opt out of sale/sharing:** The Platform does NOT sell personal data, but you can opt out of data sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising - **Right to non-discrimination:** The Platform will not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights

| Data Type | Retention Period | |-----------|-----------------| | Account information | Duration of account + 3 years after deletion | | Transaction history | 7 years (regulatory requirement) | | Customer support transcripts | 3 years from last interaction | | Browsing behavior | 2 years from collection | | Marketing preferences | Duration of account | | Payment data (tokenized) | Duration of account + removal within 30 days of account closure |

- All data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3) - PCI DSS Level 1 compliance for payment data - Regular penetration testing (quarterly) and vulnerability assessments - SOC 2 Type II certification - Data centers located in the US (Oregon, Virginia) with redundancy

- In the event of a data breach: 1. Contain the breach and assess scope 2. Notify affected customers within **72 hours** (per GDPR and most US state laws) 3. Notify relevant regulatory authorities (DPA for EU, AG for US states) 4. Provide affected customers with free credit monitoring for **12 months** 5. Publish a public incident report within 30 days

When handling customer support interactions, agents must: - **Never ask for full credit card numbers** — only the last 4 digits for verification - **Never share customer data** with other customers, sellers, or unauthorized parties - **Always verify identity** before making account changes (2 of 3: account email, phone on file, last order number) - **Mask sensitive data** in support tickets and notes (no full SSN, no full card numbers) - **Record calls only with consent** and inform the customer at the start of the call

- Collect only the data necessary to resolve the support issue - Do not retain customer data beyond what is captured in the ticket system - Redact any sensitive data inadvertently shared by the customer in chat/email --- **Policy Contact:** privacy@The Platform.com **Data Protection Officer (EU):** dpo@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Privacy complaints → Legal & Compliance at legal@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** Chief Privacy Officer
**Document ID:** POL-CN-004 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** February 28, 2026 **Department:** Order Management **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---

This policy outlines the terms and conditions for cancelling orders on the The Platform platform. Cancellation eligibility depends on the order's fulfillment stage at the time of the cancellation request.

- Orders can be cancelled for a **full refund** if the cancellation request is made **before the order enters the "Processing" stage**. - Typically, orders remain in "Confirmed" status for **1-2 hours** after placement during standard business hours. - Cancellation at this stage is instant and requires no further action from the customer.

- Once an order is in "Processing" (picked, but not yet shipped), cancellation is **attempted but not guaranteed**. - The Platform will contact the fulfillment center to attempt cancellation. This process takes up to **4 hours**. - If cancellation is successful, a full refund is issued. - If the item has already been packed/labeled, it will ship, and the customer must return it per the Returns & Refunds Policy.

- Orders that have been shipped **cannot be cancelled**. - The customer must wait to receive the package and then initiate a return. - Exception: If the carrier has not yet picked up the package (status shows "Label Created" for more than 24 hours), The Platform may intercept the shipment. In this case, a full refund is issued upon confirmation.

- Customers may cancel individual items in a multi-item order without affecting the remaining items. - The refund applies only to the cancelled item(s). - If the partial cancellation brings the order total below the free shipping threshold, the original shipping cost is **not retroactively charged** to the customer.

- Items purchased as a bundle or set must be cancelled as a complete unit. Individual items within a bundle cannot be cancelled separately. - If a bundle item is out of stock after order placement, The Platform cancels the entire bundle and issues a full refund.

The Platform may cancel an order for the following reasons: - Item is out of stock or discontinued - Pricing error (significantly below intended price due to technical glitch) - Suspected fraudulent order (flagged by the Trust & Safety team) - Customer's payment method declined after initial authorization - Regulatory or legal restrictions (e.g., age-restricted items shipped to ineligible recipients)

- Customers are notified via email and in-app notification immediately upon seller-initiated cancellation. - The notification includes the reason for cancellation and any recommended alternatives. - A full refund is issued automatically within **24 hours** of The Platform-initiated cancellation.

- If The Platform cancels an order due to a stock or pricing issue: - The customer receives a **$10 inconvenience credit** (The Platform Wallet) - Platinum members receive a **$20 inconvenience credit** - If the cancellation occurs on a time-sensitive purchase (gift with a specific event date), additional compensation up to **$50** may be offered at the discretion of the support supervisor.

- Pre-orders can be cancelled at any time before the item ships with a full refund. - No cancellation fees apply to pre-orders. - If the pre-order item's price changes between order placement and shipping, the customer is charged/refunded the difference and may cancel at that point.

- Items on backorder can be cancelled at any time before shipment. - If the estimated backorder fulfillment date is extended by more than **14 days** from the original estimate, the customer is proactively notified and given the option to cancel or continue waiting.

- Subscription orders (auto-replenishment) can be cancelled at any time through the customer's account settings. - If a subscription order has already been submitted for the current cycle, it follows the same cancellation rules as standard orders (see Section 2). - Cancelling a subscription does not affect previously shipped orders.
- Customers may pause their subscription for up to **3 months** without cancellation. - Pausing does not affect the customer's subscription pricing or discount tier.

- **Credit/Debit Card:** Refund within **3-5 business days** of cancellation confirmation - **The Platform Wallet:** Instant refund upon cancellation confirmation - **PayPal:** Refund within **3-5 business days** - **Cash on Delivery:** If the order was COD and the customer pre-paid any partial amount, refund via bank transfer within **5-7 business days** - **Gift Card/Store Credit:** Balance restored within **24 hours** --- **Policy Contact:** orders@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Order cancellation disputes → Order Management Lead at orders-escalation@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** Director of Order Management
**Document ID:** POL-SD-002 **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 **Last Updated:** March 10, 2026 **Department:** Logistics & Fulfillment **Classification:** Internal Policy — Customer-Facing ---

This policy governs all domestic shipping operations for The Platform within the United States (including territories). It covers shipping methods, delivery timelines, free shipping thresholds, and handling of delivery-related issues.

- **Delivery Time:** 5-8 business days from order confirmation - **Cost:** $4.99 per order (flat rate, regardless of weight up to 70 lbs) - **Carrier:** USPS, UPS Ground, or FedEx Ground (assigned automatically based on destination and package dimensions) - **Tracking:** Full tracking provided via The Platform order tracking page - **Availability:** All 50 US states, DC, Puerto Rico, and US Virgin Islands

- **Delivery Time:** 2-3 business days from order confirmation - **Cost:** $9.99 per order (flat rate for items under 20 lbs), $14.99 for items 20-70 lbs - **Carrier:** UPS 2-Day or FedEx 2-Day - **Cutoff Time:** Orders placed before **2:00 PM EST** ship the same business day - **Availability:** Continental US only (48 states + DC). Not available for Alaska, Hawaii, or US territories.

- **Delivery Time:** 1 business day from order confirmation - **Cost:** $19.99 per order (items under 10 lbs), $29.99 (items 10-50 lbs) - **Carrier:** UPS Next Day Air or FedEx Priority Overnight - **Cutoff Time:** Orders placed before **12:00 PM (Noon) EST** qualify for next-business-day delivery - **Availability:** Continental US only. Not available for PO Boxes, APO/FPO addresses, or rural routes. - **Restrictions:** Not available for oversized items (any dimension > 60 inches), hazardous materials, or items fulfilled by third-party sellers.

- **Delivery Time:** Within 6 hours of order confirmation - **Cost:** $14.99 (items under 10 lbs), **FREE** for Platinum Tier members - **Availability:** Select metro areas only: New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Phoenix, San Francisco, Seattle, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta, Boston, Denver - **Cutoff Time:** Orders placed before **10:00 AM local time** - **Restrictions:** Limited to items stocked in local The Platform fulfillment hubs. Not available for marketplace/third-party seller items.

- Orders totaling **$35 or more** qualify for **free standard shipping** (5-8 business days). - The $35 threshold applies to the subtotal after discounts/coupons, before tax. - Gift card purchases do not count toward the free shipping threshold. - Items from multiple sellers can be combined to reach the threshold.

- **Silver Tier:** Free standard shipping on all orders (no minimum) - **Gold Tier:** Free standard shipping on all orders + free expedited shipping on orders over $75 - **Platinum Tier:** Free standard, expedited, and overnight shipping on all orders + free same-day delivery in eligible areas

- The Platform periodically offers free shipping promotions (e.g., Free Shipping Week, Black Friday Free Shipping). These are announced via email and on the The Platform homepage. - Promotional free shipping applies only during the promotion period and follows the promotion's specific terms.

- **Standard items (The Platform fulfilled):** 1-2 business days for processing before shipping - **Marketplace seller items:** 1-3 business days, depending on the seller's processing time (displayed on the product page) - **Made-to-order/custom items:** 5-10 business days for processing before shipping - **Pre-order items:** Ship on the announced release date. Customers are notified if there are delays.

- Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays. - Orders placed on weekends or holidays are processed on the next business day. - Federal holidays observed: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day.

| Shipping Method | Cutoff Time (EST) | Delivery Speed | |-----------------|-------------------|----------------| | Standard | End of business day | 5-8 business days | | Expedited | 2:00 PM | 2-3 business days | | Overnight | 12:00 PM (Noon) | 1 business day | | Same-Day | 10:00 AM local | Within 6 hours |

- **Maximum package weight:** 150 lbs per individual package - **Items > 70 lbs:** Ship via freight carrier (LTL). Additional $49.99 freight surcharge applies. Delivery time: 7-14 business days. - **Oversized items (any dimension > 108 inches):** Must ship via freight. Customer contacted for delivery scheduling.

- **PO Boxes:** Standard shipping only. Expedited and overnight not available. - **APO/FPO/DPO (Military):** Standard shipping only. Delivery time: 10-21 business days. Free shipping for active military personnel (verification required). - **US Territories (Guam, USVI, American Samoa, Northern Mariana Islands):** Standard shipping only. Additional surcharge of $9.99 may apply. Delivery time: 10-15 business days.

The following items have special shipping requirements: - **Lithium batteries:** Ground shipping only (no air freight). Cannot ship to PO Boxes. - **Flammable/hazardous materials:** Ground shipping only within continental US. Not available for Alaska, Hawaii, or territories. - **Alcohol and tobacco:** Shipped only to states where permitted by law. Adult signature required (21+ ID verification at delivery). - **Firearms and ammunition:** Shipped only to licensed FFL dealers. Additional regulatory compliance required. - **Live animals/plants:** Expedited shipping only to minimize transit time. Not available during extreme weather periods.

- If a package arrives later than the estimated delivery window: - **Standard shipping:** The Platform offers a **$5 credit** for orders arriving 3+ days beyond the estimated window. - **Expedited shipping:** Full shipping cost refunded if delivery exceeds 4 business days. - **Overnight shipping:** Full shipping cost refunded + **$10 credit** if delivery takes more than 2 business days. - **Same-Day delivery:** Full shipping cost refunded + **$15 credit** if delivery is not completed on the ordered day.

- If tracking shows no update for **7 business days** after the last scan, the package is considered lost. - The Platform will either reship the order or issue a full refund at the customer's preference. - Lost package claims must be filed within **30 days** of the estimated delivery date.

- If a package arrives with visible damage, the customer should: 1. Photograph the damaged packaging and item(s) before discarding anything 2. Report within **48 hours** of delivery through the The Platform Returns Center 3. The Platform will issue a full refund or send a replacement (customer choice) - The customer is not required to return the damaged item.

- Carriers make up to **3 delivery attempts** for packages requiring a signature. - After the third failed attempt, the package is returned to the The Platform fulfillment center. - The customer is notified via email each time an attempt is made and can provide delivery instructions (e.g., leave with neighbor, safe spot). - Platinum members can set permanent delivery preferences in their account settings.

Customers receive automated notifications at the following stages: 1. **Order Confirmed:** Order received and payment processed 2. **Order Shipped:** Package picked up by carrier, tracking number provided 3. **In Transit:** Package en route (daily updates) 4. **Out for Delivery:** Package on the delivery vehicle 5. **Delivered:** Package delivered to the specified address

- If tracking information is not available within **48 hours** of order shipment confirmation, customers should contact The Platform support. - Tracking discrepancies (e.g., shows delivered but customer hasn't received) are handled under Section 6.2 (Lost Packages) if not resolved within 48 hours. --- **Policy Contact:** shipping@The Platform.com **Escalation:** Shipping disputes → Logistics Manager at logistics-escalation@The Platform.com **Policy Owner:** VP of Logistics & Fulfillment
